steps.en: Owner logs in and sees which fines they can furnish
steps.id: Owner login dan melihat denda yang bisa di-furnish
steps.why_en: The demo could not fetch offender details from the encrypted store; login handshake cannot be checked from the code.
steps.why_id: Saat demo data offender dari penyimpanan terenkripsi gagal diambil; proses login tidak bisa dicek dari code.

steps.en: Only fines at the set reminder stages can be furnished
steps.id: Hanya denda di tahap reminder yang ditetapkan bisa di-furnish

steps.en: Owner enters hirer or driver details and the form checks them
steps.id: Owner mengisi data hirer atau driver dan form memeriksanya

steps.en: The submission is saved as pending with its documents
steps.id: Pengajuan disimpan sebagai pending beserta dokumennya

steps.en: A scheduled job approves clean submissions; others go to staff
steps.id: Job terjadwal menyetujui pengajuan bersih; sisanya ke staff

steps.en: The furnished person becomes the current offender
steps.id: Orang yang di-furnish menjadi offender aktif

steps.en: The fine restarts at the first reminder for the hirer or driver
steps.id: Denda mulai lagi dari reminder pertama untuk hirer atau driver

steps.en: Later reminder letters and messages then target the hirer or driver
steps.id: Surat dan pesan reminder berikutnya lalu menuju hirer atau driver
steps.why_en: Letters are not generated daily and the upload to the printer is blocked by configuration; the reminder rules document is missing.
steps.why_id: Surat tidak dibuat harian dan pengiriman file ke percetakan diblokir konfigurasi; dokumen aturan reminder tidak tersedia.
